versions.author: StreamCurves regional analysis (STAF)
versions.revisionNotes: Reference condition is the fixed landscape-pressure screen least-disturbed-v1 (strict), wadeable non-canal frame. 10 of 21 stations of this ecoregion pass. 7 reference curves use local stations, 13 borrow from a wider region, 5 metrics use fixed criteria, and 4 metrics are withheld for insufficient reference support.
